allytips: Use Prophet of an Elder God to create healing opportunities by positioning Tentacles near allies.
Prioritize using Harsh Lesson on key targets to maximize damage from Tentacles.
Keep Test of Spirit active to control the battlefield and convert enemies into Vessels.
enemytips: Avoid standing in areas where Illaoi can easily create or position Tentacles.
Stay away from Illaoi after using abilities that could trigger Harsh Lesson or Test of Spirit.
Focus down Illaoi quickly to prevent her from creating more Vessels and healing herself.
